definition: The Government of Canada's employment website. An employer applying for a Labour Market Impact Assessment must advertise the position on Job Bank as part of the required recruitment activities, and needs a Job Bank for employers account to submit through LMIA Online.
longform: For a high-wage position the advertising on Job Bank must run for at least 4 consecutive weeks within the 3 months before applying, alongside at least 2 other recruitment methods appropriate to the occupation.
